(<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8801" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8801/hovercard">#8801</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/wenshao/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/wenshao">@wenshao</a></li> <li>Added an idle watchdog to kill silent sandbox hangs after 20 minutes and implemented stale container reaping to prevent leaked runners from consuming resources. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8816" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8816/hovercard">#8816</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/wenshao/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/wenshao">@wenshao</a></li> <li>Extended the environment variable denylist to prevent untrusted workspace .env values from leaking into session subprocesses and hardened the scrub lifecycle. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8763" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8763/hovercard">#8763</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/wenshao/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/wenshao">@wenshao</a></li> <li>Session-switch errors now list specific blocking background tasks with their IDs and statuses, directing users to the correct commands to stop them. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8742" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8742/hovercard">#8742</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/yiliang114/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/yiliang114">@yiliang114</a></li> <li>Daemon-owned runtimes can now complete authorized external text writes via built-in tools without disabling ACP delegation or widening workspace boundaries. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8852" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8852/hovercard">#8852</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/doudouOUC/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/doudouOUC">@doudouOUC</a></li> <li>Fixed a bug where setting QWEN_CODE_SERVE to 0 or false incorrectly removed NODE_OPTIONS and NODE_PATH during direct ACP launches. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8811" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8811/hovercard">#8811</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/yiliang114/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/yiliang114">@yiliang114</a></li> <li>Fixed an issue where refreshing a provider template incorrectly reset the user's selected model if that model belonged to a different provider. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8868" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8868/hovercard">#8868</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/yiliang114/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/yiliang114">@yiliang114</a></li> <li>Ported remaining hardening improvements to the verify gate to prevent unnecessary full re-runs caused by identity-less failures. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8878" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8878/hovercard">#8878</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/wenshao/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/wenshao">@wenshao</a></li> <li>Fixed sandbox container name collisions in shared daemon environments by switching to random 8-character hex suffixes for container names. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8880" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8880/hovercard">#8880</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/wenshao/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/wenshao">@wenshao</a></li> <li>Fixed the provider update prompt to respect the 'Remind me later' choice by persisting a 24-hour cooldown instead of re-prompting on every startup. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8829" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8829/hovercard">#8829</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/qwen-code-dev-bot/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/qwen-code-dev-bot">@qwen-code-dev-bot</a></li> <li>Review comments posted via /review are now formatted with proper paragraphs and lists to improve readability when unresolved Criticals or coverage disclosures are present. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8825" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8825/hovercard">#8825</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/wenshao/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/wenshao">@wenshao</a></li> </ul> <h3>Performance</h3> <ul> <li>The review process now guarantees compose and submission survive budget stops by reserving a 20-minute floor for composition before verification. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8791" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8791/hovercard">#8791</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/wenshao/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/wenshao">@wenshao</a></li> <li>Automatic review timeouts for micro diffs under 25 lines are now halved to reduce latency while maintaining high effort and inline comments. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8774" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8774/hovercard">#8774</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/wenshao/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/wenshao">@wenshao</a></li> <li>Code review performance is improved for diffs over 3000 lines by reducing audit rounds and disabling the specialist agent to prevent timeouts. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8773" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8773/hovercard">#8773</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/wenshao/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/wenshao">@wenshao</a></li> <li>Made the triage job timeout configurable via the QWEN_TRIAGE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES repository variable to prevent premature cancellations of long-running checks. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8810" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8810/hovercard">#8810</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/wenshao/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/wenshao">@wenshao</a></li> </ul> <h3>Documentation</h3> <ul> <li>Korean (한국어) has been added to the documentation language bar in the README to provide direct access to localized guides. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8836" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8836/hovercard">#8836</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/dss1222/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/dss1222">@dss1222</a></li> </ul> <h3>Internal Changes</h3> <ul> <li>Synchronized the external-context workspace version in the dependency lockfile to prevent unnecessary local install churn and working tree dirtiness. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8858" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8858/hovercard">#8858</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/wenshao/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/wenshao">@wenshao</a></li> <li>Removed the legacy /demo debug page from the daemon as its functionality is fully covered by the main Web Shell interface. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8805" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8805/hovercard">#8805</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/wenshao/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/wenshao">@wenshao</a></li> <li>Improved Web Shell session switching to retry when a target session is still closing instead of immediately reporting a permanent error. (<a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8864" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8864/hovercard">#8864</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/yiliang114/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/yiliang114">@yiliang114</a></li> </ul> <h2>New Contributors</h2> <ul> <li><a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/dss1222/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/dss1222">@dss1222</a> made their first contribution in <a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8836" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/8836/hovercard">#8836</a></li> </ul> <p><strong>Full Changelog</strong>: <a class="commit-link" href="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/compare/v0.21.8...v0.21.9"><tt>v0.21.8...v0.21.9</tt></a></p>

> Meta is releasing Muse Glimmer under an Apache 2.0 licence for local AI agents that can run on a consumer GPU. The company’s Superintelligence Labs has released the 30-billion-parameter model’s weights on Hugging Face. Meta says developers can use it for local coding, function calling, local agents, and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.
